items.task: Create a real-life situation that uses multiplication and division fact families. Record the quantities and explain your reasoning.
Find one example at home/school of division as equal sharing and grouping. Draw or photograph the representation and label it.
Design a pair activity for mental division strategies. Each partner must explain the answer in a different way.
Collect two measurements or observations connected to long division using place value and compare them.
Make a small poster teaching remainders and exact division to a younger learner. Include one worked example.
Invent a challenge based on factors, divisibility and mathematical statements; exchange it with a classmate and check the solution.
